name: fix176_special_arrows
verifies: fix-176: every special arrow and bolt ends its flight as its CP 1.75 template (gCProjectile_PS TouchBehavior/LinkToBones, Game.dll OnTouch): the explosive arrow bursts with eff_magic_weapons_explosivearrow_impact_01 on a wolf and on the ground and is gone (KillSelf), and sets the wolf on fire (quality 8, full draw); fire arrows set it on fire, poison arrows poison it; plain, sharp, fire and poison arrows stick to a bone; the blunt arrow falls off the body; bolts stick in the body and bounce off the ground (Reflect)
steps: spawn Wolf attitude=neutral dist=12 side=front as=w
spawn Wolf attitude=neutral dist=12 side=front as=w2
log plain arrow into the ground: Stick in earth/grass-less terrain (unknown material) or Drop on a hard G3 material
spawn Wolf attitude=neutral dist=12 side=front as=w3
notes: fix-186: an NPC's hp is capped at its maximum (the wolf's 400; max= sets only the hero's), so the wolf is healed before the fire arrow and fresh wolves take the blunt arrow and the bolts: burns, poison and five arrows killed the first one (editor fix-186), the blunt arrow and the bolt flew over the body into the ground (Drop). G3 evidence in Docs/combat.md §2 (fix-176). The explosive arrow's blast is only an effect (sound + VFX_Magic_Weapons_ExplosiveArrow_Explosion_01 particles): no area damage, no knock-back; the hit is the arrow's own (30 + bow, Missile, burning quality 8). The ground at flat_field_1 is terrain: without a G3 shape material arrows stick there [interp].
